Filipino Spaghetti

Of course, the Filipino Pasta experience is not complete without
the
Filipino
Spaghetti.
It‘s
sweeter
compared
to
its
European
version
—
and
is
formulated
after
banana
ketchup
instead
of
tomato
sauce.
Our
spaghetti
is
an
acquired
taste
and
some
foreigners aren’t fond of it, while others praise it relentlessly for

being surprisingly good.

The point is — I want you to be able to try it too (even if
only the instant version for now). There are two here, so if
Lara wants to try it she can have some (but feel free to keep
it to yourself if you want to :P).
